description: This file defines a utility enum 'MicRefreshSupport' that manages microphone refresh logic, including observing audio input devices, scheduling refresh tasks, selecting microphone names, and binding voice wake state within an application.

methods.name: startObserver
methods.description: Starts observing an audio input device using the provided observer and triggers a refresh callback when an event occurs.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a refresh task with a specified delay, cancels any existing scheduled task, and executes the provided async action.

methods.name: selectedMicName
methods.description: Retrieves the microphone name from a list of devices based on the selected device ID, using key paths for UID and name.

methods.name: voiceWakeBinding
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI binding to the voice wake enable state in the app, allowing UI to reflect and modify this state.
